info.title: Student Nest API
info.description: Broker-free student housing marketplace. All routes are under /v1 except /health and /ready. Errors use `{ error: { code, message, details? }, requestId }`; lists use `{ items, nextCursor, hasMore }`.

type.description: listing_view or listing_impression. Any other type (including server-side ones) is dropped, not rejected

sessionId.description: Random per-install id (not a device id). Dedupes guest views

example.issue: must be a valid ISO 8601 date string

uploadUrl.description: Upload the file here within 10 minutes

headers.description: Headers the upload request must send

note.description: Free text for the other party
